Frequently asked questions

How much do student moves cost in Scotland?

Pricing depends on volume, distance, and date. A room or partial flat often suits man with van. Quote online for a live price.

Do you help with student moves in Glasgow and Edinburgh?

Yes. We cover university cities across Scotland including Glasgow and Edinburgh. Book early around term changeover.

Can you move a single room or partial flat?

Yes. Man with van is often the best fit for smaller student loads. List your items in the quote wizard.

When should students book their move?

As early as possible before September and June peaks. Last-minute slots depend on crew availability.

Do you offer storage drop-offs?

Yes. Add storage as the delivery address in the quote wizard, or mention it in your notes.
